tokenize_text_with_simple_tokenizer: create a SimpleTokenizer instance and tokenize text strings into BPE token IDs with a fixed context length
encode_decode_with_simple_tokenizer: encode raw text to token IDs and decode token IDs back to text using SimpleTokenizer
tokenize_with_bert_tokenizer: create a MyBertTokenizer instance and tokenize text into input IDs and attention masks for BERT models
tokenize_with_distilbert_tokenizer: create a MyDistilBertTokenizer instance and tokenize text into input IDs and attention masks for DistilBERT models
tokenize_with_gpt2_tokenizer: create a MyGPT2Tokenizer instance and tokenize text into input IDs with optional BOS token for GPT-2 models
